one_liner: Admin-configurable portal that teleports players to a saved position when they enter the trigger zone.
primary_use_case: Provides a simple way for world admins to set a teleport destination and have players automatically moved there via a portal trigger.
preview_recommendation: Add a screenshot or short video showing the portal UI button and the teleport effect when a player enters the portal.
manifest_quality_notes: Position can only be set by admin players
Uses world state to persist position across sessions
